⚙️ Options

🖥️ Graphics

Is the game stuttering, or is the machine getting loud? Drop one level. This setting belongs to this machine and does not travel with the save file.

🔊 Volume

Takes effect immediately. All the way left = muted.
Sound effects = the engine in flight: a deep rumble that grows louder with more thrust and denser air – in vacuum almost nothing is left, and that is on purpose. If you fly a Raptor (Superheavy or Starship too), you also hear the original recording of a real Raptor engine including the turbopump spin-up at ignition.

🎥 Camera

How much the camera shakes along at ignition, staging and reentry mitzittert.
An engine lighting up rattles – that is what makes the thrust tangible that the HUD numbers only claim. The shake is purely cosmetic and changes nothing about the trajectory. If watching it makes you queasy, set the slider to 0 %: the image then holds perfectly still without the graphics suffering for it.

⌨️ Key bindings

For reference only – the keys are fixed and cannot be remapped. That way the same key does the same thing on every machine, and a shout for help from the next desk is explained in one sentence.
